prs.tagLine: Feel at home in this  well-connected  North Dublin coastal suburb

The Brickworks, Station Manor is located in the picturesque village of Portmarnock. You have all the convenience of great transport links to the city center and beyond, easy access to the M50 and Dublin Airport. Portmarnock Village is a short stroll away which provides for your every need with an excellent choice of retail and services. Numerous grocery stores, coffee shops, restaurants can all be enjoyed in this desireable neighborhood. The Stunning beaches in Portmarnock open up a wide variety of leisure activities and the famous silver strand beach offers views of Ireland's Eye, Howth Head, and Lambay Island. 

Only a short distance away are the neighboring villages of Malahide and Howth with an abundance of additional amenities and services.

listing.title: Market Square, Main Street, Kilcullen, Co. Kildare
listing.seoTitle: Market Square, Main Street, Kilcullen, Co. Kildare

seller.name: Robert Hickey, Director of Residential Lettings

prs.tagLine: Stunning apartments on the banks of the River Liffey
prs.location:
Kilcullen is situated off the Dublin to Waterford (M9) motorway, between Naas and Kilkenny, and is centred on the crossroads of the R413 and R448 regional roads.

Kilcullen straddles the River Liffey and is about 50 km (31 mi) from Dublin, under 5 km (3 mi) from Newbridge, and also close to Kildare Town and Naas. 

Kilcullen benefits from a primary school and secondary school in the village and there are ample shops, bars & restaurants all in walking distance of Market Square. 

Kilcullen also benefits from a number of other public amenities, including a library, a health centre, and Kilcullen Community Centre which offers top class sports and leisure facilities.

listing.seoTitle: The Grange, Celbridge Road, Maynooth, Co. Kildare

prs.tagLine: Secure long term tenancies in  high quality homes
prs.location:
The scheme will be located near the town centre where there is easy access to shops, medical facilities, recreational facilities,  various school (both National and Secondary) and childcare facilities along with  3rd level education (Maynooth university). Maynooth Business campus along with Carton Retail Park provide employment opportunities locally. 

The scheme is on the edge of Maynooth town adjacent to the M4 motorway which bypasses the town connecting the town with Dublin and the west - Athlone, Galway & Sligo. Maynooth is also on the Dublin-Sligo railway line and is served by InterCity train services (connecting Maynooth to Dublin city and suburbs) The train station is located approx. 850 meters from the estate. The town is also serviced by Bus Eireann which connects the town with various towns / cities throughout the country.
